about: A pushed commit's Release-note trailer cannot be rewritten, because main is never force pushed. Where one was wrong, the note that replaces it is written here, by the commit's full hash, and scripts/release-notes.py reads it in the trailer's place. Each says why.

26dedfcca7a4442014053ae670e8f361a00a5a7d.why: Entry 462 section 3's third note named the speed unit, which the notes check reads as a file path; the note says it in words.

notes.note: Across the computer and the phone, nothing is cut off at small window sizes or the largest text any more: table headings, long choices and labels wrap, trimmed names show in full when you point at them, and the hint inside an empty box is easy to read. (Entry 462, 3)
A save, a print or a file that will not open now says so in the middle of the window, as other failures do, instead of in a small line, on the computer and the phone. (Entry 462, 3)
Speeds read in feet a second everywhere, and the phone names distances and lengths as the computer does. (Entry 462, 3)

f1d775ea501a92b9f98c0335192b0da02aca6f02.why: Entry 266's README commit said the application did not change, but it also changed one word in the volunteer pack, which ships; nightly 120 refused it.

notes.note: The printed volunteer pack's ruler check now spells center the American way, as the rest of GroupLab does. (Entry 266)

9a41376b9ca332cf62d723afe27071067158f41a.why: Entries 279 and 280's licence note named Apple's testing service by its product name, which the note check reads as a name only this repository knows; nightly 123 refused it.

notes.note: Fudd buster mode, Unholy's idea, shows with your own shots why a few shots mislead: the tightest and widest three-shot groups among them, what averaging small groups would have said, and the zero chased five shots at a time. (Entry 279, 3)
On the phone, a target GroupLab did not print can now be marked by hand: set a known length and the aim point, then add each hole under a crosshair that stays in the middle. (Entry 279, 2)

The status bar now says when the target was saved and where, with Show in folder, and it saves by itself once you change or accept it; Settings can switch to a Save button instead. (Entries 279 and 281)
A tap on a number now switches that number alone, and GroupLab remembers the unit for that figure; the others follow Settings as before. (Entry 280, 1)
GroupLab's license now allows it to be distributed through Apple's App Store and its test service, as work on an iPhone and iPad version begins. (Entry 279, 1)

02fb365c31dbfb93f6e70c09b00fab424385da30.why: Nightly 130 refused the note: the checker reads the name of Apple's test service as a code name (as it did for nightly 123).

notes.note: GroupLab for iPhone and iPad keeps the image analysis it needs when the application is linked, ahead of the first test build for Apple devices. (Entry 290)

notes.note: GroupLab for iPhone and iPad keeps its settings and records working in the release build, ahead of the first test build for Apple devices. (Entry 290)

67e8f1686b110f64c48abf4aedf3559e081dee68.why: Nightly 130 refused the note: the checker reads the name of Apple's test service as a code name (as it did for nightly 123).

notes.note: GroupLab for iPhone and iPad now builds with the Xcode 26 tools, ahead of the first test build for Apple devices. (Entry 290)

ddbd3e51616fd96ed84e6277226b6984207b8541.why: Nightly 130 refused the note: the checker reads the name of Apple's test service as a code name (as it did for nightly 123).

notes.note: GroupLab for iPhone and iPad now builds and is tested on the simulator, ahead of the first test build for Apple devices. (Entry 290)

8e207c79ef8cb4de3467a6aaf511c6ca59272d8f.why: Entry 381's note spelled millimeters the British way, and nightly 174 refused it.

notes.note: Printing straight to the Phomemo M834 from Android now prints the whole page: GroupLab keeps the connection open until the printer says it has finished, instead of stopping after a few millimeters. (Entry 381)

4893d78216f5eb1d998879fbd27ab5ccfc773d80.why: Entry 400's commit promised a third sooner; the same day its codes read at once were taken back after the Mobile suite hung on macOS, leaving about a tenth.

notes.note: On the phone, a photographed GroupLab target's result comes up about a tenth sooner after the picture is taken, measured by running the phone's own reading on a computer. (Entry 400)

1392641a77f7413dd39748f48eddcd8f993afebd.why: Entry 417's note spelled centers the British way, and nightly 191 refused it twice.

notes.note: On a flatbed scan, GroupLab now finds the holes that show the scanner's white lid through them, centers them, snaps a hand-placed hole to its middle, and lets you drag a hole again after clicking a bull; thank you to Quack for the report. (Entry 417)

e52cd430d7056fdf6d23d70a0c80b3e9e20a0f70.why: Entry 425's CI fix said changing the text size or the theme could no longer close GroupLab, but the change behind it was taken back in the next commit: the restyle that failed was most likely made by test windows left open, which are closed now, and the application's own restyle is as it was.

notes.note: The ballistic solver's warm-up when GroupLab starts is now checked to run in the background by where it runs, not by how long it took on a busy computer. (Entry 425)

ad75f8713a5975bdfccd5e6330f631cc152d0996.why: Entry 457's note named GitHub, which the notes' checks read as a name in code; the checks.yml release notes check failed on it.

notes.note: Make a report now sends from GroupLab: write what happened and press Send, and the report goes to the project with its error and logs, with email or an issue on the project's page only when sending cannot be done. (Entry 457)

7e4b1719bf59ab011109888aff74aa26fd925630.why: Entry 459 section 6: the commit changed the website and the consent record that ships beside the Windows sample, and its note spoke of the website, which the notes never list.

notes.note: Nothing in GroupLab changes; the consent record beside the Windows download's sample sheet now also covers the research pages' pictures. (Entry 453)

5d96309d21e648693666f4602c11e0e15a8d4bf5.why: Entry 459 section 6: the note described the notes and the website, not what the application does.

notes.note: A target GroupLab sends now says whether it went by itself or because you pressed Send, one word and nothing personal, so the notes can say where the targets behind a detection change came from. (Entry 458)

5f6d02692c4d98330162d38567a0cc720f4bab9c.why: Entry 461's note named Android's screen reader by its product name, written as one word with a capital inside, which the release notes refuse as a name only this repository knows.

notes.note: With the screen reader on Android, the outline now sits on the control being read rather than above it, and the More buttons and the bulls to tap are a full finger's size. (Entry 461, 2.1)
